headline: Hira Norm climbs 701 places into ARC-2 top 100

sections.text: Hira Norm climbed from 764th to 63rd, gaining 5.27 points to reach 35.83 on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The move puts Norm inside the top 100 after starting the day outside the top 500.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
